text:
The first mouse eradication program on Gough Island commenced in 2021, carried out by the Gough Island Restoration Programme; an earlier attempt planned for 2020 was delayed by COVID-19. The note's claim that mice were introduced only in recent decades by a modern research station is incorrect—house mice reached Gough Island in the 19th century, likely via sealing or whaling vessels.  
CONFIDENCE: 95
